title: Kaplan-Meier Survival
code:
library(survival)
library(ggnext)
# Kaplan-Meier survival: time by sex
d <- data[complete.cases(data[, c("time", "status", "sex"), drop = FALSE]), , drop = FALSE]
d$sex <- factor(d$sex, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
# Event = the higher of the two values of status
status_values <- sort(unique(d$status))
d$event <- as.integer(d$status == status_values[2])
km <- survfit(Surv(time, event) ~ sex, data = d, conf.int = 0.95)
km_summary <- summary(km)$table
logrank <- survdiff(Surv(time, event) ~ sex, data = d)
logrank_p <- pchisq(logrank$chisq, length(logrank$n) - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
p_km <- ggnext(d, aes(time = time, status = event, color = sex)) +
  geom_km(conf_int = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Kaplan-Meier survival", x = "Survival time (days)", y = "Survival probability") +
  theme_modern()
